http/internal/hpack_tables#

The HPACK tables (RFC 7541 §2.3): fields, the static table and the dynamic table with its eviction.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The HPACK tables (RFC 7541 §2.3): fields, the static table and the dynamic table with its eviction.

Internal to the http modules; programs do not import it.

Public API#

object HpackField#

object HpackField

Opaque octet strings. Compression accepts pseudo-fields and control octets; actual HTTP field/message validity is checked above this internal layer.
